_about.method: Primary source is the cookbooks themselves - 53% of ingredient lines carry a publisher-tested gram figure beside the volume, giving one density observation each. Aggregated by median with outlier trimming; observations below 1/8 cup discarded (gram roundings at tsp scale are ~30% noise). Liquids use curated specific-gravity constants, because a book printing "(240 ml)" states a volume identity, not a weight. Curated solid values fill gaps where library coverage was thin.
_about.purpose: Volume-to-mass conversions for vegan recipe extraction. Reusable: load this instead of re-deriving.
